doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR4: Each event displays a visual indicator (icon) above the object with a countdown timer showing time remaining. FR28: The game visually distinguishes event priorities through color coding (minor: soft blue, standard: light yellow, critical: orange/red).

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Event Priority Colors: Minor Events: #64b5f6 (soft blue), Standard Events: #fff176 (light yellow), Critical Events: #ff8c42 (orange/red). Background/Apartment: Dark Night: #1a1f2e (main apartment background).

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.section: Game Event System Pattern, Project Structure
doc.snippet: EventManager maintains active events array. EventIndicator components render for each active event. Component receives event object with all properties (type, priority, location, timer). Component calculates position from event.location (percentage-based coordinates).

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.section: Story 2.7: Event Icons and Visual Indicators
doc.snippet: Story 2.7 focuses on visual polish: priority colors, visibility, stacking. Component structure is solid, needs styling enhancements. Priority color classes already exist in CSS, need to verify they match UX design.

doc.title: Story 2.6: Event Types and Interaction Requirements
doc.snippet: Event types are fully defined with correct priorities. Icon mapping already exists in EventIndicator component (EVENT_TYPE_ICONS). Event type to priority mapping is in EventManager.

doc.title: Story 2.4: Event Spawning System
doc.snippet: EventManager.spawnEvent() creates events. Events added to GameContext.activeEvents array. Events have all required properties (type, priority, location, timer). Event indicators render automatically when events spawn.

artifact.reason: Main component to enhance. Already has basic implementation with EVENT_TYPE_ICONS mapping and PRIORITY_CLASSES. Needs priority color verification, visibility improvements, and stacking logic.
CSS module with priority classes already defined. Has drop-shadow filters and pulse animation. Need to verify colors match UX design exactly (#64b5f6, #fff176, #ff8c42).
Manages event lifecycle. updateEvents() updates timers every frame. Events removed from activeEvents on resolution/expiration. Provides event data with type, priority, location, timer.

Type definitions for events. GameEvent interface includes type, priority, location, timer. EventType union: 'phone' | 'kettle' | 'cat' | 'candle'. EventPriority union: 'minor' | 'standard' | 'critical'.
Provides activeEvents array to components. addEvent() adds events to state. removeEvent() removes events from state. EventIndicators component reads activeEvents from this context.
Game constants including event scoring, coziness impact, and interaction text. Priority values defined: 'minor', 'standard', 'critical'. Constants match PRD specifications.

Apartment container component. Event indicators are positioned relative to this container. Provides containerRef for position calculation. Dark background (#1a1f2e) requires good visibility for indicators.

constraint.description: EventIndicator component already exists at src/components/game/EventIndicator.tsx. Component receives GameEvent object with type, priority, location, timer properties. Component uses CSS Modules for styling. Absolute positioning relative to apartment container. Follow architecture document "Event System Pattern" section.

Priority colors must match UX design exactly: Minor: #64b5f6 (soft blue), Standard: #fff176 (light yellow), Critical: #ff8c42 (orange/red). Colors applied via CSS classes or inline styles. Drop shadows or glow effects ensure visibility against dark background (#1a1f2e).

Events use percentage-based coordinates (0.0 to 1.0) for responsive positioning. EventIndicator converts percentages to pixel positions based on container size. Absolute positioning relative to apartment container. Transform translate(-50%, -50%) centers indicator on event location. Stacked events need offset calculation to prevent overlap.

Use CSS transforms for animations (GPU-accelerated). Minimize re-renders (React.memo if needed). Efficient position calculations. Lightweight animations (pulse, glow effects). CSS transitions for smooth position updates.

EventIndicator integrates with GameContext (reads activeEvents). Component receives containerRef for position calculation. Integrates with Apartment component (positioned relative to apartment container). Event removal handled by GameContext state updates. Prepare for timer display in Story 2.8 (timer already shown, may need enhancement).

Icons are Unicode emoji (📱, ☕, 🐱, 🕯️) - prepare for future SVG integration. Drop shadows and glow effects ensure visibility. Pulse animation draws attention (already implemented in CSS). Critical events have faster pulse animation for urgency.

interface.name: EventIndicator Component Props
interface.signature: interface EventIndicatorProps { event: GameEvent; containerRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>; }

interface.name: EventIndicators Component Props
interface.signature: interface EventIndicatorsProps { events: GameEvent[]; containerRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>; }

interface.name: GameEvent Interface
interface.signature: interface GameEvent { id: string; type: EventType; priority: EventPriority; location: { x: number; y: number }; timer: number; points: number; cozinessReward: number; cozinessPenalty: number; interactionText: { en: string; uk: string }; }

interface.name: EVENT_TYPE_ICONS Mapping
interface.signature: const EVENT_TYPE_ICONS: Record<GameEvent['type'], string> = { phone: '📱', kettle: '☕', cat: '🐱', candle: '🕯️' }

interface.name: PRIORITY_CLASSES Mapping
interface.signature: const PRIORITY_CLASSES: Record<GameEvent['priority'], string> = { minor: styles.priorityMinor, standard: styles.priorityStandard, critical: styles.priorityCritical }
